what_this_is: The Workshop row for the tool in tools/what-is-waiting-on-me: everything waiting on a person, merged from the places they keep it.

payload.label: Show everything waiting on me
payload.job: Show everything waiting on this person that only they can do, gathered from every place it is kept: what their AIs asked them for, drafts to approve, work that is stuck, a sign-in, a decision
payload.description: Give sources (the places that hold things up, the person's own list: { id, label, title, where?, detail?, opens?, at?, most? }) and found (the records of each source, { <source id>: [{ id, value }] }, read from the person's account by the caller). A record waits when every where test holds (equals, in, present or absent on a field). Answers one card per waiting record, newest first, with the title, detail and the address it opens read from the record by the source's templates, a count for each source, and a sentence. A source with no records handed in is told as unread, never as nothing waiting. The tool reads no records and names no source: a new place is a new row.

title.description: A template over the record's fields, {path} holes

at.description: The field that holds when it started waiting

card.description: Additional card fields mapped from a dotted record path or {value} or {template}.

found.description: The records of each source, by source id

words.description: The sentences an answer says, over read-data/waiting-words.json

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows

payload.label: Read what is waiting on me
payload.job: Read every configured waiting source through its current owner and gather its cards
payload.description: Reads the person’s record:waiting-sources rows over declared source DATA, gathers each source through its record query or current reader tool, and uses the same source-row aggregator as what-is-waiting-on-me. Missing adapters and failed, partial or bounded reads stay unread; complete is true only when every declared source is read whole with no skipped cards. Answers sections, finishes, source coverage and problems. Source definitions are managed through their own record rows; source reads are read-only; AI-doable cards are delegated by the shared hold owner, which publishes their ai-job:hold-* records before hiding them. It returns the remaining human sections.

stored.description: What this run reads of the person's own things, read by the caller from where the person keeps them (the engine keeps none) and given here: records: [{id, type, value}] of record:waiting-sources, record:waiting-on-you, ai-job, post, setting (the row setting:needs_you_hold_rules), ai-job (ids starting ai-job:hold-), as this row's `stored` lists. What is not given is not there.

keep.description: What the run made, for the caller to keep where the person keeps it: rows {id, type, value} (value null removes), settings {label, value}, files {file, base64}. The run itself writes nothing.

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows

payload.label: Finish a waiting item
payload.job: Complete the declared action on the same persisted waiting record
payload.description: Works out the declared same-record completion of waiting records and answers it as a records:write input; it writes nothing. Read the records first (records:read or records:list, each { id, type, value }) and hand them in as records; hand in the person's record:waiting-sources records as sources when they added any. Refuses items whose source has another owner. The built-in asks action is the original Waiting on you list status Done transition; no other source status is guessed. Answers completed (the ids), changed (how many records the write changes) and write: each record's new value expecting the value it was read with. Send write at @own-records with records:write, then run tool:verify-waiting-on-me-completion on the records read back. A record already carrying this request_key's receipt answers completed with no write.

showed.description: What each finished round showed, by its exact card id.

records.description: The waiting records to complete, as records:read or records:list gives them: [{ id, type, value }].

sources.description: The person's record:waiting-sources records as records:list gives them, when they added sources of their own.

write.description: The records:write input that keeps the completion: { id, type, value, expected } for each record that changes.

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows

payload.label: Verify a waiting completion
payload.job: Read the same persisted target and verify the current effect of a waiting completion
payload.description: Checks, on the waiting records handed in (read them again with records:read after the write, each { id, type, value }), the saved completion key and BLAKE3 effect identity against the source's declared fields, and answers completed/next_round only when that same effect still holds. A hidden card, unavailable feed or historical command result proves nothing here. Hand in the person's record:waiting-sources records as sources when they added any. Reads and changes nothing in the person's records.

records.description: The waiting records as read now, as records:read or records:list gives them: [{ id, type, value }].

sources.description: The person's record:waiting-sources records as records:list gives them, when they added sources of their own.

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows
